ex_en: I can't answer that question for you.

ex_lb: An dësem Wuert gëtt déi virlescht Silb betount.
ex_en: In this word the stress is on the penultimate syllable.

ex_lb: Ech kann däi Behuelen net begräifen.
ex_en: I can't understand your behaviour.

ex_lb: Dat do betrëfft eis net.
ex_en: That doesn't concern us.

ex_lb: Vun der Festung hu mer e puer Maueren erhalen.
ex_en: A few walls of the fortress have survived.

ex_lb: D'Mamm erënnert d'Kanner un hire Rendez-vous beim Coiffer.
ex_en: Mum reminds the children of their hairdresser's appointment.

ex_lb: D'Muttergottes ass dem Meedchen an der Grott erschéngen.
ex_en: The Mother of God appeared to the girl in the grotto.

ex_lb: Hie klëmmt op d'Leeder, fir eng nei Bier anzedréien.
ex_en: He climbs the ladder to screw in a new bulb.

ex_lb: Well et glat war, ass de Camion an de Gruef gerëtscht.
ex_en: Because it was slippery, the lorry slid into the ditch.

ex_lb: Déi iewescht Klasse ginn de Mëtteg schwammen.
ex_en: The upper classes go swimming this afternoon.
